title: Size of the strict w-local construction
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $\kappa$ an infinite cardinal with $|A|\leq\kappa$. Let $C_A$ be the algebra defined by the strict w-local construction [def-weil-pbc-strict-w-cover], namely $W=A^w$, $E=W^{\mathrm e}$, and $C_A=E_{[V(IE)]}$ where $I$ is the radical ideal defining the closed points of $\operatorname{Spec}W$. Then $|C_A|\leq\kappa$.
